known.via: English Wikipedia "Solano County Green Valley AVA"

climate: Most rain falls in winter. Dry summers keep mildew and rot down, though young vines may need watering.

blurb.text: A small North Coast valley AVA in Solano County, east of Napa Valley, about one mile wide and four miles long between the Vaca Mountains and the Mount George Range. Solano County is added to the name to tell it apart from Green Valley in Sonoma. Chardonnay is the county's main grape.
